newsitem.title: USA: ING Barings hires New York equity trading official.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings hires New York equity trading official.

text.p: Bob Betack has joined ING Barings as managing director and head of equity trading, based in New York, the company said.
ING Barings said in a March 25 statement that Betack would oversee both desk and floor trading for the Americas office.
Betack had been president and global head of trading at Caspian Securities in New York. He was one of Caspian's founding partners and helped launch the firm's trading operations.
ING Barings is a unit of the Netherlands' ING Groep NV.
